name: Kubinashi Aiko
source:
The president of the arts club and the only third year student member.

She's a very diligent arts club member, and she's participated in various drawing competitions in the past.

When she joined the club, it was little more than a meeting place for delinquents, and her serious and calm personality really stood out at the time.
On the other hand, now she's very lax towards the newer club members.
